attchmntText: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited published its Unaudited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, via newspaper advertisements in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 13, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the standalone results on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, total income from operations was Rs. 10,655.33 lakhs, with a net profit after tax of Rs. 269.42 lakhs. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income from operations was Rs. 20,748.03 lakhs, with a net profit after tax of Rs. 776.40 lakhs. The company reported a net worth of Rs. 7,175.865 lakhs and a debt equity ratio of 3.03. The results are subject to limited review by statutory auditors. Additionally, the document contains public notices regarding the commencement of insolvency resolution processes for personal guarantors Vijayalakshmi R and Mr. K Raghavendra Rao, creditors of M/s. Orchid Pharma Limited, with claims submission deadlines set for December 4, 2026.

attchmntText: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ace Integrated Solutions Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The company reported a loss before tax of 46 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 120 Lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the loss before tax was 46 Lakhs, compared to 120 Lakhs in the previous year. The statutory auditors, Sanmarks and Associates, issued a review report stating that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The company has no subsidiaries as its wholly-owned subsidiary was liquidated in March 2025, so consolidated results are not required. Earnings per share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, were negative 0.33 INR. The financial results are available on the company website and NSE.
